review.algorithm_assessment: Order-preserving KMP characterizes each new pattern position by an earlier equal value, or nearest lower/upper value representatives. These relations are necessary and sufficient given a matched prefix. Use identical relation checks to build failure links and scan cow values, allowing actual values to differ from rank labels while preserving ties and strict ordering. O(K*S+N).
review.limitations: One source reviewer plus actual isolated tests, not independent dual semantic review.
